title: Agents have no supported route to create a ROOT session (with agent and model); only parent-scoped child delegations can be spawned
outcome: A coordinator can provision a fresh root session (a named agent such as Codex with a model such as gpt-6.1-sol, in a given workdir) through a supported, documented, authority-checked tool or API, instead of needing Greg to create it in the UI. Who may create root sessions, and how many, is decided before implementation.
acceptance: Agents have no supported route to create a ROOT session (with agent and model); only parent-scoped child delegations can be spawned is done
